## Checklist

- [ ] Opened against `dev` (`main` is for releases)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, in English
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for renderer changes
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG-developer.md` and `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] No version bump (the maintainer does that at release time)
- [ ] New dependencies are checked for license and added to `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] Protocol stays compatible with older servers and apps
